task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First step, go to the north. Then, make an effort to venture west. After that, go to the south. And then, move west. And then, attempt to take a trip north. And then, pick-up the burger from the floor of the spare room. And once you've done that, you win!
description:

You can see a saucepan. The saucepan is ordinary. But the thing is empty.

You need an unblocked exit? You should try going east. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going north. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.
